properties.displayName: NovaSteel: only Microsoft.Fabric/capacities may be declared under Microsoft.Fabric
properties.description: Guardrail operationalizing implementation-guide.md §9.2 and the azure-infrastructure task instruction 'do not provision unsupported Fabric SaaS items': Fabric workspaces, Eventstreams, Eventhouses, Lakehouses, pipelines, notebooks, semantic models, and Power BI reports are Fabric SaaS-plane items with no supported Microsoft.Fabric ARM resource type as of this policy's authoring date. This policy denies any Microsoft.Fabric/* resource type OTHER than Microsoft.Fabric/capacities, so that if a future preview ARM type appears under the Microsoft.Fabric namespace it cannot be silently deployed without a deliberate policy update and re-review.
